static_traits.name: Wang Danni
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, limited contact with family
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support system, limited social interaction, hard to discuss personal troubles with others
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, can reflect on his own patterns, high cooperativeness, steady tone, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I am very unproductive in all areas of life outside of work, which leads to my lacking motivation and a sense of self-worth; the problem already affects maintaining relationships and self-care, and has become more pronounced in recent months.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because I realized low motivation and productivity in personal areas are affecting my overall happiness and health.
growth_experiences: For a long time, in personal life domains outside work, feeling a lack of productivity and motivation (describing oneself as 'it has been like this since I can remember', markedly worsening in recent months), more obvious when comparing with others, causing difficulty maintaining relationships and self-care.
During periods of high work pressure, he repeatedly experienced low motivation and low self-worth; though work performance was acceptable, personal-life tasks were harder to push forward.
Weak social and family support: living alone, limited contact with family, overall weak social support system, hard to discuss personal troubles with others.

core_beliefs: I lack personal discipline and work ethic
I am not as productive as others

special_situations.event: Comparing with those others whose 'lives are in perfect order'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as organized and efficient as they are, it means I am lazy or a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing attempts and avoiding personal tasks to avoid being proven a failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others, I am lazy

special_situations.event: Facing personal tasks lacking external structure (such as self-care, diet plans, relationship maintenance)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without clear external structure I do not do well, and will surely fail in the end
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastination and avoidance, only handling things when there is no choice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do it, I will fail

special_situations.event: Reviewing performance after making a change plan but not yet sticking to it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot always complete plans, it proves I am essentially lazy and hopeless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopping attempts after one failure, reinforcing self-denial and negative labels

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Feeling stressed means my ability is inadequate, proving I cannot do it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further reducing action and socializing in personal life, to lower anxiety

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a capable and self-disciplined person, to have structure and achievement in personal life as in work, and to maintain stable relationships and a sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fear of appearing inferior after comparison, judged lazy and worthless; fear that failure after trying intensifies shame
defense_goal: Lowering failure-and-shame anxiety through avoiding personal tasks and self-reproach; staying in the structured work environment to maintain a minimum sense of self-worth

object_relations.self_representation: A not-disciplined-enough self, prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others are organized, efficient judges/standard holders
Others/family are distant objects from whom support is hard to obtain

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When comparing herself with others or being asked about personal life arrangements and progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting comparison as 'essentially lazy, worthless', attributing personal-area inadequacy to a stable personality flaw
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Low tone, tending toward self-blame, using labeling language like 'I cannot do it / I am lazy', magnifying flaws, downplaying strengths, and avoiding further exploration of concrete feasible change paths.

manifestations: Long-term feeling that personal life lacks motivation and direction, equating self-worth with productivity
Hard to start and persist with tasks in personal domains
Living alone, limited contact with family
Little social interaction, hard to discuss personal troubles
Feeling disordered and out of control in personal life lacking external structure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently labels self as 'lazy' and 'lacking self-discipline'
Excessive self-denial after comparing with others, lowering action willingness

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'strong personal work ethic and high self-discipline' as an absolute standard that must be reached
If not reaching the standard, immediately deeming himself a failure

positive_force: In a structured environment (work), can stably complete tasks, with transferable execution and persistence abilities
Positive attitude; willing to try new methods (such as behavioral experiments)
Having self-reflection ability and clear expression
negative_force: Habitually comparing with others and self-denying
Attributes problems to stable personality defects ('laziness', 'lack of self-discipline')
Lacking social support, living alone, limited contact with family
When facing unstructured tasks, predicts failure and avoids action

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding and procrastinating daily tasks and self-care in personal life (insufficient motivation, difficulty getting started)
antecedent: Feeling inferior after comparing with others
Facing personal tasks lacking clear structure or goals
During work stress increases or low mood
target_behavior.core_reason: Labeling inadequate productivity as 'lazy', and catastrophically predicting 'I will fail / cannot finish', withdrawing to avoid shame and failure
target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and self-shame, briefly lowering anxiety and pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged maintenance of interpersonal relationships, declining diet and self-care, overall well-being and lowered sense of self-worth
